name: KeyStone
description: Jobs, grants and visa routes in one place. Its CV scoring and rewriting call AI models through Lodestone, on Netlify Functions.

name: TouchStone
description: The governance layer for AI builders: describe a product, paste code or point it at a URL and get a structured audit across eight domains. Its model calls run through Lodestone: choosing and replacing models, time limits, fallbacks to other providers, spend limits and plain-language failures.

name: Inkstone
description: Brand-voice writing, sourced by default: it writes in a company's voice, won't put a figure in a draft it can't attribute to a named source, and a person signs off before anything ships. Its model calls run through Lodestone. The first call in each cold serverless function waits for the current model catalogue (about 0.4 s), so a model OpenRouter has withdrawn is dropped before it is tried, instead of costing one of the three free attempts.

name: Naija Eval
description: An independent, reproducible scorecard for N-ATLaS on Hausa, Igbo and Yoruba, and the first evaluator to publish model-scorecard/1.
